reviews.title: Awful app
reviews.text: By far one of the worst apps of its genre. In fact, calling this pile of garbage an app is being generous. If you want to view nonstop ads, be pestered by notifications (not sure why a night light app would even need to push any), or be tracked across your device, then go ahead and download this. As soon as I opened it I was prompted with monthly subscriptions, notifications, app rating, etc. if you ever make it to using this as an actual night light, you’re lucky. Overall, absolute garbage by greedy, useless “developers.”
